assumptions.description: Independent standardized uniform U,V,E on [-sqrt(3),sqrt(3)], independent age, female membership and Bernoulli glycemic class D. BMI/glucose share U with residual correlation rho=0.25. These unreported dependencies, independent nuisance covariates and bounded tails are structural assumptions, not zero-covariance facts or biological cutoffs.

Direct law for the post-selection Jansen source analytical population: adult continuous age with reported mean/SD, female=1 and male=0; all members satisfy the reported self-report diabetes/anemia/missingness exclusions by scenario declaration. No parent-population selection mechanism or exact regression-row reconstruction is claimed. The law itself keeps FPG below 7. Original weights/intercept/sample are unresolved; equal-weight intercept-including qualified projections are used.

Two separate source age/sex-adjusted slopes constrain two population projections. Conditional residual BMI/FPG correlation 0.25, independent age/sex and linear additive HbA1c identify joint coefficients only after these assumptions. Age coefficient 0.005 percent/year and female coefficient -0.03 percent are unsupported working assumptions, not supplied regression results.

Share the derived joint BMI/glucose coefficients and assumed age/sex terms across source contexts and the selected target. Apply plasma-to-central-serum identity in numerical units as an unverified measurement/transport assumption, not a conversion justified by NGSP. Target age composition is discrete uniform 35 through 74; other target means/SD and sex fraction use MIND summaries as scenario anchors despite older rural selection, time offsets and assay differences. No national representativeness or target calibration is claimed.

An independent latent elevated-glycemia class has target probability 0.10, glucose shift 4 mmol/L and total HbA1c shift 1.8 percent. These are explicit unestimated mixture assumptions, not disease prevalence estimates or diabetes/treatment exclusions. Center class effects to preserve specified means. Preserve specified total glucose/HbA1c variances by deriving positive within-class variances; never clip or resample observations.

Bao qualified analytic sensitivity context uses the identical affine law with separately declared source parameters: age uniform 25-75, female source count ratio, BMI mean 23.5 and SD 2.6, glucose mean 5.4/within-class SD 0.46, HbA1c mean 5.69/residual SD 0.4, class probability 0.05 and shifts 4/1.8. Center/spread choices are assumptions informed by source median/IQR, not exact quantile matching, CI-to-SD conversion or a fitted Pearson target. Age support is a declared subset scenario, not reported source bounds. Class members are assumed previously undiagnosed; other source eligibility is assumed satisfied after selection. Native fasting plasma/HPLC percent are retained; equal weighting is qualified.

MIND Spearman is contextual only. This candidate does not supply a post-imputation, age-61-80 MIND joint rank law, tie reconstruction or source rows; ordinary covariance algebra cannot evaluate its Spearman functional. Do not convert it to Pearson or fit the target correlation to it. MIND mean/SD transfer does not transport its rank association automatically.

Reported points remain fixed scenario inputs. Jansen printed interval confidence levels/SE are unresolved; Bao/MIND correlation uncertainty and pair counts are unavailable. No SE derived from these, no precision weighting, pooled loss or tolerance. Within-row random variation is separate from external estimation, structural and transport uncertainty. Repeated seeds are synthetic sampling only.

Jansen regressions and marginal records reuse the same source family and are not independent confirmations. Bao records reuse SHDS II; MIND records reuse MIND-China. These are distinct named families, but cross-source participant overlap is unconfirmed and no independence precision benefit is claimed. NGSP representations are the same evidence, not duplicates.

Generated target rows cannot reconstruct any source population. All target-table source diagnostics are unavailable, including marginal and relationship comparisons. Separate deterministic source-context calculations are qualified analytic checks, not source replay or target validation.

This whole-cohort scenario generates all five variables without participant input. No individual measurement is recovered. E1/E2 are transport-dependent projections; E3 is algebraically fixed at the assumed 0.005 percent/year because age is independent of other factors and enters additively. This is not a new age-effect estimate. No causal, clinical-p-value, calibrated uncertainty or publication-readiness claim.

design.derivation: 3000 and column schema from task; technical identifier prefix does not represent people.

unit_mapping.derivation: Official affine unit relation; slopes multiply only by 0.09148.

source_projection_constraints.derivation: Solve the two separate adjusted source projection equations after specifying residual covariance. These are not combined-regression coefficients. Exact formula in analytic/derive.py and mathematical_properties.md.

structure.derivation: Explicit structural choices: standardized uniform factor law, rho 0.25, age 0.005 and female -0.03 percent; source does not identify these.

target_context.derivation: Age support/composition from task plus uniform assumption. MIND mean/SD and count ratio are transported scenario anchors, not observed target values. Class parameters are assumed; variance decomposition derives residual SDs. Serum units align nominally but assay/selection equivalence is unestablished.

source_contexts.derivation: Jansen source mean/SD matched under declared selected law, source age bounds mean +/- sqrt(3)*SD are assumed. Bao context choices are separate approximate location/scale and mixture assumptions, not a fitted source reconstruction or exact quantile conversion. Each context uses the same law as generator with its named parameters.
